description: This file defines React components and utility functions for rendering and managing dialog modals using primitives from @radix-ui/react-dialog, along with animations from framer-motion. It exports various dialog parts such as overlay, content, header, footer, title, and description, facilitating their composition in React applications.

methods.name: cn
methods.description: Utility function to concatenate class names, filtering out falsey values.

methods.name: DialogOverlay
methods.description: A React component that renders a backdrop overlay for the dialog, with fade-in and fade-out animations applied via framer-motion.

methods.name: DialogContent
methods.description: A React component that renders the main content of the dialog, including overlay, animated container, and children.

methods.name: DialogHeader
methods.description: A simple React component that renders the header section of the dialog.

methods.name: DialogFooter
methods.description: A React component that renders the footer actions of the dialog.

methods.name: DialogTitle
methods.description: A React component that renders the title of the dialog, using Radix's primitive.

methods.name: DialogDescription
methods.description: A React component that renders the description or subtitle of the dialog.
